segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin generally report a matte, powdery finish and no added shine, though a few found the formula too greasy or slick for their liking.
segments.dry: One reviewer notes it helps keep skin hydrated without feeling drying, describing it as moisturizing rather than stripping.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive, reactive, or eczema/rosacea-prone skin repeatedly report no stinging, irritation, or allergic reaction, calling it gentle enough for daily use.
segments.mature: A reviewer approaching 45 with melasma found it nourishing and effective without greasiness, and another describes it as good for aging oily skin.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination, breakout-prone skin reports no irritation or new breakouts after months of daily use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it alongside anti-aging concerns (melasma, fine lines) report the product feels nourishing and doesn't worsen dryness; one mature reviewer with melasma was satisfied with results after weeks of use.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe the finish as hydrating or moisturizing rather than drying, including one using prescription retinoid who says it's the only sunscreen that doesn't dry out her skin.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea report reduced redness and no irritation; one specifically says it lightens red spots on her face, though one reviewer with general redness reports a white cast making her redness more visible.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with reactive, eczema- and rosacea-prone skin report no triggering of their conditions and describe the formula as compatible with compromised or sensitive barriers.
concerns.spots: One reviewer using retinoid treatment reports no increased dryness or irritation on skin also dealing with sun spots, and a mature reviewer with melasma reports satisfaction after a few weeks.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no breakouts and call it non-comedogenic; one explicitly says it stopped her frequent breakouts, though this is self-reported short-term.
concerns.oiliness: The large majority of reviewers, including those with oily skin, report a matte or powdery finish with no added shine or greasy feel; a minority (2 reviews) found it left a persistent greasy, tacky film that never dried down.

aspects.libelle: Greasy, slick feel that doesn't dry down
Faint musty or slight scent noted

extraits.texte: Really wanted to love this sunscreen as I have been on the hunt for a non comodogenic mineral face sunscreen. Unfortunately for me it was just too greasy. I loved the feel when it went on, it's really velvety soft, but it never dried down. It left a a greasy slick feeling on my face even with a small amount. So now I'm on the hunt for something different and will be using the rest on my body.

The Mineral Creme SPF 50 is the holy grail of mineral sunscreens, it is the best I have used of any other mineral sunscreen on the market! Please do not change anything with this formulation! It really does apply like cashmere on the skin and there is no white cast and no pilling which is amazing. I have very sensitive acne prone, porcelain skin and red hair and this looks gorgeous on, like my own skin color but smoother; I add mascara, blush and lipstick and out the door I go for a beautiful and protected look. I especially love that this formula (and the MDSolar Sciences SPF30 tinted) does NOT have niacinamide nor Vitamin E as I am allergic to niacinamide and vitamin E breaks out my chin terribly and so I greatly appreciate that MDSolarSciences offers these two excellent high quality sunscreen products without those two potentially irritating ingredients. Great job with this product, thank you for making it, you have a loyal customer.

Uh-mazing!!!! Four sunscreens later and I finally found my own personal "holy grail." I have oily skin, recently diagnosed with type 2 rosacea after 10 years of struggling with what I thought was acne. This sunscreen does not go on thick or oily. It's almost powdery and stays matte. It lightens the red spots on my face, I sometimes don't even need my Erborian BB cream in the morning. I'm very happy and thankful to have come across this brand. MDSolaris for the win!!

extraits.texte: I tried to use mineral spf before with no success, my skin is so oily that every brand I tried was heavy or made my face itchy, reason why I've only used the physical spf for so many years. As I approach 45 years of age, I wanted something better, more nourishing but still effective because I also have melasma. I decided to give this one a try and couldn't be happier with the results!! I've been using it for a couple weeks now and I can say with confidence that it's a great product. It didn't make my skin greasy, it didn't cause me any itchiness or breakouts. My skin feels and looks better than before. I wanna try the tinted version of it too. If you deal with oily skin like me, give it a try! I recommend this product!

This is my 3rd time purchasing this sunscreen because no other sunscreen has worked as good as this one for me, I have sensitive acne prone very reactive skin and this sunscreen doesn't irritate my skin and it helps with any redness on my skin as well. Little bit of a white cast but just blend it very well and it disappears.

extraits.titre: Finally found the best sunscreen ever
extraits.texte: I absolutely love this sunscreen. I have rosacea and it doesn't irritate my skin. Goes on light and smooth. Great under my makeup and I don't get greasy throughout the day the way some sunscreens can make me do. I no longer have to look for the perfect sunscreen because I have finally found it. You have a customer for life.
It's moisturizing yet doesn't create any greasiness. I have aging oily skin and I like how this absorbs into my skin and works well with my foundation.
